items.title: EngageSDK Vulnerability Exposes Millions of Crypto Wallet Users to Cyberattacks

items.title: Hackers Use AiTM Session Hijacking to Redirect Employee Salaries in New Storm-2755 Campaign
items.description: A financially motivated threat group called Storm-2755 has launched a campaign that quietly reroutes employee salary payments to attacker-controlled bank accounts. Targeting Canadian workers, the group uses adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) techniques to hijack authenticated sessions and bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA), in what researchers have labeled “payroll pirate” attacks.​ The…
